title: Rainbow Ride
coordinateSystem: Y up; source coordinates /100; yaw degrees from +Z toward +X
routeActions: Walk along the entrance ledge, then jump onto the first pasta carpet. Remain on it until it begins moving.
Jump forward over the raised beam around X 62. Return to the moving carpet and avoid the flame cone before the central landing.
Jump to the original central landing. Cross the rotating octagonal platforms; run, crouch and jump across their gaps.
Follow the northern ledge to the second carpet. Board it near [12.2, -10.6, -36.5].
Jump the raised beam near X 31. Later jump onto the two-step arch around [41.5, 8.8, -16.2] and [38.5, 9.82, -16.2], then return to the carpet.
Hop onto the slab near [29.5, 10.33, -16.2]. Punch the pasta box and keep pace with the carpet until it emerges beyond the slab.
At the junction take the right carpet at [15.8, 10, -1.8]. The left carpet leads to the big house.
During the spiral, jump over the rotating bridge arms. A standing crouch jump gives extra height; steer back onto the carpet.
Near the end jump across the source raised beams at [38.8, 25.19, 1.4], [34, 24.68, 1.4] and [29, 25.7, 1.4]. Rejoin the carpet below.
Jump past the last triangular obstacle onto the falling pasta tiles. Cross to the western tile and use a standing crouch jump to the high gangway.
Follow the gangway to the ship. Fight the deck wind, then jump onto the raised bow and collect the first star.
